categories.content: Flaunch Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via flaunch.gg.

categories.name: STX.CITY Ecosystem
categories.content: STX.CITY Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via STX.CITY.

categories.name: SPL22
categories.content: SPL22 is a hybrid token extension of the Solana blockchain that combines the features of both fungible and non-fungible tokens.

categories.name: RWAfi
categories.content: Protocols whose core product is DeFi functionality built on top of tokenized real-world assets issued by third parties. Where RWA Protocols handle issuance, these protocols take an already-tokenized asset as input and make it financially productive: separating an asset's yield from its principal, lending against it as collateral, providing or managing its liquidity, constructing baskets from it, or routing value into it. Protocols in this category represent a claim on protocol activity and are not themselves backed by real-world assets.

categories.name: ERC20i
categories.content: ERC20i is a token standard on Base blockchain that extends the capabilities of ERC-20 tokens by adding native inscriptions.

categories.name: Time.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: Time.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via time.fun.

categories.name: Surge Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched via Surge, a multichain "Internet Capital Markets" platform designed for AI-native startups and revenue-generating businesses.

categories.name: Reddit Points
categories.content: Reddit Community Points are blockchain tokens that are owned and controlled by a specific Reddit community. With these point tokens, a community member can own a piece of their favorite subreddit. The points can be earned through contributions in the community such as post creation, comments, and content moderations.

categories.name: Tokenized Pre-IPO Stocks
categories.content: Tokenized Pre-IPO Stocks are on-chain proxy instruments that offer fractional exposure to private companies, allowing users to trade the value of high-growth startups before they reach public stock exchanges.

categories.name: Wormhole Assets
categories.content: The Wormhole project is a bidirectional, decentralized SPL token bridge between Solana and EVM chains.

categories.name: Pump Fund Portfolio
categories.content: Projects and tokens officially backed by Pump Fund, the venture arm of Pump.fun. These projects are selected for their adherence to "build in public" principles, transparent development, and verified founder commitment.

categories.name: Argus Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Argus (https://argus.world/), the permissionless token launchpad native to Arc.

categories.name: NFTStrategy Ecosystem
categories.content: NFTStrategy is an automated protocol that converts crypto trading fees into buying and selling floor NFTs, creating a self-sustaining value loop for NFT collections.

categories.name: Trading Card RWA Platform
categories.content: Trading Card RWA Platforms tokenize physical collectible cards (e.g., Pokémon, sports cards) on a blockchain. The physical cards are stored with a custodian or vault, and each blockchain token represents ownership of the real-world card. This enables features such as fractional ownership and global secondary trading.

categories.name: Fractionalized NFT
categories.content: NFT that is being divided into smaller pieces which have more affordable pieces.

categories.name: NFT Strategy Flywheel
categories.content: The NFT Strategy Flywheel is a DeFi-NFT hybrid model that automates NFT accumulation and token burning using trading fees to drive continuous buy pressure and value accrual for token holders.

categories.name: MXN Stablecoin
categories.content: Stablecoins that maintain a stable value by reference to the Mexican peso (MXN).

categories.name: Coinbase Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokenized U.S. equities issued by Coinbase and deployed on Base under its B20 tokenized equity standard, launched in 2026 for non-U.S. customers. Tokens are identified by a "C" suffix appended to the underlying ticker and can be traded onchain on DEXs.

categories.name: Duck-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins which are inspired by duck.
